question: Build a stacked ensemble model using LASSO (alpha=0.1), Random Forest (n_estimators=100, max_depth=10), and XGBoost (n_estimators=100, max_depth=5) as base learners and Ridge (alpha=1.0) as meta-learner to predict patient length of stay from EHR data. Use an 80-20 train-test split (random_state=42). Generate out-of-fold predictions using 5-fold cross-validation (random_state=42) as meta-features for the Ridge meta-learner. Train each base learner on the full training set to evaluate on the test set. Report test MAE for each base learner and the stacked ensemble.
